title: Non-interactive, line-range staging for git (and for coding agents)
smallest_useful_product: git stage-lines path/to/file.ts:12-18,40 other.py:3 computes the working-tree vs index diff, selects exact changed lines, and updates the index non-interactively; deletions use old-side line numbers prefixed by a minus; --unstage, --dry-run, and agent wrappers are included.
constraints: Positive ranges use new-side line numbers; minus-prefixed ranges use old-side line numbers. Text files and CRLF normalization are supported; binary files are rejected without changing the index.
